name: Deardocs
author: Surya Prasad Khanal

sections.description: Deardocs is a powerful documentation plugin for WordPress that helps you create beautiful, searchable, and organized documentation for your products or services. With an intuitive interface and powerful features, it\’s perfect for creating user manuals, knowledge bases, help centers, and more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the deardocs folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Deardocs > Settings to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
How do I create my first documentation?

Go to Deardocs > Add New in your WordPress admin to create your first documentation page.

Can I organize my documentation into categories?

Yes, you can create categories and subcategories to organize your documentation.
